summary:
Field Shift is a web platform that turns NASA Earth observation data into practical farming decisions for farmers. We developed an interactive dashboard that uses NASA POWER data to give each farm satellite-based insights, along with soil health diagnostics, crop recommendations, water management guidance and a digital twin of the farmland. Its core feature is an AI-powered Crop Rotation Planner that helps farmers decide what to grow season after season, keeping the soil healthy and reducing weather-related risk.
Many farmers lack easy access to satellite data and expert advice, and repeating the same crop depletes soil and wastes water. Field Shift addresses this by bringing NASA data into one simple platform, available in English, Tamil and Hindi, with audio read-aloud and downloadable PDF reports. A Community Hub also lets farmers share knowledge with each other. By helping farms adapt to changing conditions with trustworthy data, Field Shift supports healthier soil, efficient water use and more resilient livelihoods.
details: Field Shift is a web platform we built to help farmers make better decisions using NASA Earth observation data. Many farmers don’t have easy access to satellite information or expert advice, and growing the same crop season after season slowly wears out the soil and wastes water. To tackle this, we brought everything into one simple dashboard. A farmer opens their farm profile (we used a demo farm in Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu) and can look at a digital twin of their land, check NASA POWER climate and satellite insights, review soil health, get crop recommendations, plan water use, and share ideas with other farmers in a community hub. The heart of the project is our Crop Rotation Planner, which suggests what to grow in each coming season so the soil stays healthy, risks from weather and pests are spread out, and yields improve over time. We made the platform available in English, Tamil and Hindi, and added a “Listen” button and a downloadable PDF report so that farmers who are not comfortable reading or using technology can still benefit. We built the website using [HTML, CSS and JavaScript / your actual tech stack] and hosted it on GitHub Pages, so it runs in any browser without special hardware. Our recommendations are based on NASA POWER data and [describe briefly how your crop recommendation and rotation logic works]. Throughout the project we thought about accessibility, trust in the data, long-term sustainability of farmland, and how easily the platform could be extended to farms in other regions. We hope Field Shift helps farmers adapt to changing conditions with confidence and protect their land for the future.
